name: crosspet-plus-workspace
description: Original CrossPet desktop app with a Clawd task, approval and remote service

scripts.setup: npm run prepare:desktop && npm --prefix desktop ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix desktop test && npm run test:plus
scripts.build:service:win: npm run prepare:desktop && npm --prefix desktop run build:win:dir
scripts.test:plus: node --test tests/crosspet_service.test.js tests/macos_plus_build.test.js tests/macos_plus_update.test.js tests/crosspet_bridge_cleanup.test.js tests/terminal_command.test.js tests/macos_tray_assets.test.js
